title: Gate
summary: Lower the level where it falls below a threshold (the pauses between words) by up to a set range. Opens slightly ahead of speech, so onsets are kept, then holds and fades out. Only ever reduces.

params.title: Threshold
params.help: Below this the gate closes. auto = 6 dB above the scope's noise floor (the 10th percentile of its 10 ms levels).

params.title: Range
params.help: How far the level goes down when the gate is closed. A moderate range keeps some room tone; 0 leaves the audio untouched.

params.title: Look-ahead
params.help: How far ahead of the level rising the gate opens.

binding_hints.note: auto sets the threshold 6 dB above the noise floor.
